from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from core.agent_capability_policy import BudgetRequest, DataClassification, PolicyContext, PolicyRequest, RiskLevel
from core.agent_external_research_service import execute_external_research


def test_live_public_network_canary():
    docker = shutil.which('docker')
    assert docker, 'DOCKER_COMMAND_NOT_AVAILABLE'
    lock = Path('infra/agent-reach/versions.lock')
    assert lock.exists(), 'AGENT_REACH_VERSIONS_LOCK_NOT_FOUND'

    caps = frozenset({'EXTERNAL_RESEARCH'})
    scopes = frozenset({'external:web'})
    ctx = PolicyContext(
        user_allowed_capabilities=caps,
        agent_allowed_capabilities=caps,
        environment_allowed_capabilities=caps,
        policy_allowed_capabilities=caps,
        user_allowed_scopes=scopes,
        agent_allowed_scopes=scopes,
        environment_allowed_scopes=scopes,
        policy_allowed_scopes=scopes,
        budget_limits={
            'runtime_seconds': 60,
            'files_changed': 0,
            'lines_changed': 0,
            'external_calls': 1,
            'sql_rows': 0,
            'inference_cost_usd': 0.0,
        },
    )
    req = PolicyRequest(
        capabilities=caps,
        scopes=scopes,
        risk=RiskLevel.R1,
        data_classification=DataClassification.PUBLIC,
        budgets=BudgetRequest(external_calls=1),
        external_egress=True,
        production_allowed=False,
        privilege_expansion=False,
        procedure='agent-reach-external-research',
    )

    out = execute_external_research(
        {'allowed': True},
        'OpenAI official website',
        req,
        ctx,
        lock,
        timeout_seconds=30,
        docker_binary=docker,
    )

    assert out.evidence.allowed is True
    assert out.evidence.production_touched is False
    assert out.evidence.external_calls_budget == 1
    assert out.evidence.procedure == 'agent-reach-external-research'
    assert out.evidence.effective_scopes == ('external:web',)
    assert out.result is not None, out.evidence.reason
    assert out.result.success is True, out.evidence.reason
    assert out.evidence.returncode == 0
    assert 0 < out.evidence.stdout_bytes <= 65536
